data_tooling.name: build-your-own-x
data_tooling.summary: Build-Your-Own-X 是一个精心编排的教程集合，通过从零开始复现各种技术来教授编程，帮助开发者通过动手实践理解系统内部原理。其核心方法是将复杂系统分解为可学习的组件，展示基础概念如何组合成复杂工具的技术思路。你可以用它构建从数据库到游戏的各种项目，在探索常用工具底层原理的同时获得实用技能——这种“边做边学”的方式非常适合想要通过主动创造来深化编程理解的开发者，为技术成长提供了一条清晰的实践路径。
data_tooling.summary_en: Build-Your-Own-X is a curated collection of tutorials that teaches programming by recreating technologies from scratch, helping developers understand system internals through hands-on implementation. Its technical insight lies in breaking down complex systems into learnable components, demonstrating how foundational concepts combine to create sophisticated tools. You can use it to build anything from databases to games, gaining practical skills while exploring how your favorite tools work under the hood—perfect for deepening your programming knowledge through active creation.

edge_embedded.name: RAG_Techniques
edge_embedded.summary: RAG_Techniques是一个开源教程库，专注于检索增强生成技术，通过结合外部知识检索与文本生成，解决大语言模型信息滞后和准确性问题。项目基于LangChain和LlamaIndex等框架，演示了优化检索策略、融合多源数据等高级方法，帮助开发者提升系统上下文感知能力。其Jupyter Notebook示例可直接用于构建智能客服或研究助手等可靠AI应用，读者可借鉴架构设计，实验不同RAG组合，创建具备实时知识更新的生成式AI工具。
edge_embedded.summary_en: RAG_Techniques is a comprehensive tutorial repository demonstrating advanced methods for Retrieval-Augmented Generation systems, which address the challenge of making large language models provide accurate, up-to-date information by combining external knowledge retrieval with text generation. It showcases practical implementations using popular frameworks like LangChain and LlamaIndex, teaching key insights such as how to optimize retrieval strategies and integrate diverse data sources. Developers can use these Jupyter Notebook examples to build more reliable AI applications, experiment with different RAG architectures, or enhance existing chatbots with contextual awareness for domains like customer support or research assistance.

edge_embedded.name: pyrite64
edge_embedded.summary: Pyrite64 是一个开源任天堂64游戏引擎和编辑器，让开发者能用现代工具创作N64风格游戏。它基于libdragon和tiny3d库构建，提供了集成编辑功能的精简开发环境，特别适合学习N64时代渲染架构和游戏逻辑设计。你可以用它快速原型复古游戏、研究低多边形渲染技术，或通过扩展其模块化C++代码来定制开发工具。
edge_embedded.summary_en: Pyrite64 is an open-source Nintendo 64 game engine and editor that enables developers to create N64-style games using modern tools. It builds on libdragon and tiny3d libraries to provide a streamlined development environment with integrated editing capabilities. You can use it to prototype retro games, study N64-era rendering techniques, or build custom tools by extending its modular C++ architecture.

ui_devex.name: qwen-code
ui_devex.summary: Qwen-Code 是一个在终端中运行的开源 AI 助手，旨在帮助开发者直接在命令行环境中自动化编码任务，无需切换工具界面。它通过大型语言模型理解自然语言指令并生成或修改代码，其核心设计亮点是将 AI 能力无缝嵌入现有开发流程，保持工作流的连贯性。你可以用它快速创建模板代码、重构文件或通过描述问题来调试，适合日常开发中提升效率，尤其适合喜欢终端操作的程序员尝试集成到自己的工具链中。
ui_devex.summary_en: Qwen-Code is an open-source AI agent that operates directly in your terminal, enabling developers to automate coding tasks without switching contexts. It leverages large language models to understand natural language commands and generate or modify code, with the technical insight being its seamless integration into existing development workflows through terminal-based interaction. You can use it to quickly generate boilerplate code, refactor existing files, or debug by describing issues in plain English, making it practical for accelerating daily development cycles.

ui_devex.name: convert
ui_devex.summary: Convert是一款通用的在线文件转换工具，旨在解决不同文件格式互不兼容的常见问题，通过网页端实现无缝的格式转换。其技术核心基于TypeScript开发，确保了类型安全和代码可维护性，能稳健处理多样化的文件转换逻辑。用户可直接在浏览器中使用它转换文档、图像等多种文件，无需安装额外软件；开发者也可将其集成到Web应用中，为项目添加即时转换功能，适合日常办公或开发场景中的灵活应用。
ui_devex.summary_en: Convert is a universal online file converter that solves the common frustration of incompatible file formats by providing a web-based tool for seamless format transformations. Its technical strength lies in being built with TypeScript, enabling robust type safety and maintainable code for handling diverse file conversion logic. Developers can integrate it into web applications for on-the-fly conversions, or users can directly access its interface to convert documents, images, and other files without installing software, making it practical for everyday digital tasks.

You can use it to prototype retro games, study N64-era rendering techniques, or build custom tools by extending its modular C++ architecture.

summary_short.zh: Pyrite64 是一个开源任天堂64游戏引擎和编辑器，让开发者能用现代工具创作N64风格游戏。它基于libdragon和tiny3d库构建，提供了集成编辑功能的精简开发环境，特别适合学习N64时代渲染架构和游戏逻辑设计。你可以用它快速原型复古游戏、研究低多边形渲染技术，或通过扩展其模块化C++代码来定制开发工具。

agents_workflows.name: composio
agents_workflows.summary: Composio 是一个开源 TypeScript 框架，旨在简化 AI 智能体的开发流程，通过统一接口接入 1000 多种工具和 API，解决开发者集成多源工具的繁琐问题。其核心设计是将工具发现、身份验证和执行管理抽象为标准化层，让开发者能专注于智能体逻辑而非底层连接。你可以用它快速构建能执行实际任务的智能体，例如数据分析或自动化流程，在沙盒环境中测试不同工具组合，探索如何将自然语言指令转化为具体操作，从而加速实验和原型开发。
agents_workflows.summary_en: Composio is an open-source TypeScript framework that simplifies building AI agents by providing unified access to 1000+ tools and APIs. Its technical innovation lies in abstracting tool discovery, authentication, and execution into a single interface, allowing developers to focus on agent logic rather than integration complexity. You can use it to quickly prototype agents that perform real-world tasks like data analysis or workflow automation, experimenting with different tool combinations in its sandboxed environment to test capabilities before deployment.

agents_workflows.name: RAG_Techniques
agents_workflows.summary: RAG_Techniques是一个开源教程库，专注于检索增强生成技术，通过结合外部知识检索与文本生成，解决大语言模型信息滞后和准确性问题。项目基于LangChain和LlamaIndex等框架，演示了优化检索策略、融合多源数据等高级方法，帮助开发者提升系统上下文感知能力。其Jupyter Notebook示例可直接用于构建智能客服或研究助手等可靠AI应用，读者可借鉴架构设计，实验不同RAG组合，创建具备实时知识更新的生成式AI工具。
agents_workflows.summary_en: RAG_Techniques is a comprehensive tutorial repository demonstrating advanced methods for Retrieval-Augmented Generation systems, which address the challenge of making large language models provide accurate, up-to-date information by combining external knowledge retrieval with text generation. It showcases practical implementations using popular frameworks like LangChain and LlamaIndex, teaching key insights such as how to optimize retrieval strategies and integrate diverse data sources. Developers can use these Jupyter Notebook examples to build more reliable AI applications, experiment with different RAG architectures, or enhance existing chatbots with contextual awareness for domains like customer support or research assistance.

agents_workflows.name: qwen-code
agents_workflows.summary: Qwen-Code 是一个在终端中运行的开源 AI 助手，旨在帮助开发者直接在命令行环境中自动化编码任务，无需切换工具界面。它通过大型语言模型理解自然语言指令并生成或修改代码，其核心设计亮点是将 AI 能力无缝嵌入现有开发流程，保持工作流的连贯性。你可以用它快速创建模板代码、重构文件或通过描述问题来调试，适合日常开发中提升效率，尤其适合喜欢终端操作的程序员尝试集成到自己的工具链中。
agents_workflows.summary_en: Qwen-Code is an open-source AI agent that operates directly in your terminal, enabling developers to automate coding tasks without switching contexts. It leverages large language models to understand natural language commands and generate or modify code, with the technical insight being its seamless integration into existing development workflows through terminal-based interaction. You can use it to quickly generate boilerplate code, refactor existing files, or debug by describing issues in plain English, making it practical for accelerating daily development cycles.

security_safety.summary: Convert是一款通用的在线文件转换工具，旨在解决不同文件格式互不兼容的常见问题，通过网页端实现无缝的格式转换。其技术核心基于TypeScript开发，确保了类型安全和代码可维护性，能稳健处理多样化的文件转换逻辑。用户可直接在浏览器中使用它转换文档、图像等多种文件，无需安装额外软件；开发者也可将其集成到Web应用中，为项目添加即时转换功能，适合日常办公或开发场景中的灵活应用。
security_safety.summary_en: Convert is a universal online file converter that solves the common frustration of incompatible file formats by providing a web-based tool for seamless format transformations. Its technical strength lies in being built with TypeScript, enabling robust type safety and maintainable code for handling diverse file conversion logic. Developers can integrate it into web applications for on-the-fly conversions, or users can directly access its interface to convert documents, images, and other files without installing software, making it practical for everyday digital tasks.
